title: How advertisers make us spend money
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Which advertising technique works on you most easily: discounts, influencers, scarcity, emotion, or something else?
Have you ever bought something and later realised an advert had influenced you more than you expected?
Is personalised advertising useful, intrusive, or both?
Should adverts aimed at children follow stricter rules than adverts aimed at adults?
If you were designing an ethical advert, what would you refuse to do even if it increased sales?
